en: Acquire Dawnwoven Fabrics by weaving cloth into bolts while in close proximity to the Crusader's Loom. Return to Taylor once you have enough.

This loom is special. Did you know that? All of our craftsmen had their tools of the trade blessed by our high priests.

In particular, the loom attracts stray fabrics and thread destined to be used in the holiest of our ceremonial vestaments. Over time, we will have enough gathered to create a new robe, and these days are a cause for celebration, for me at least.

If you are interested in the process for your own curiosity, thread some bolts near the loom and watch the Light at work.
Heal $1oa Injured Deathguard with your Holy Light ability.

I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others. 

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
